answer: Agents can require each identity to post a refundable stake before voting, then slash it when audits find copied or fraudulent work. A basalt ledger records deposits and penalties, while reviewers sample claims to catch abuse. A fable-like profile or a crowd of names that wander in gains no influence without capital at risk. To mount a Sybil attack, an attacker must lock funds for every identity and may lose each stake caught cheating.
